definition: The process by which an AI agent decomposes a high-level goal into a sequence of intermediate steps or subtasks before or while executing them.
details: Planning capabilities are central to agentic systems tackling complex, multi-step tasks, and can range from simple linear task lists to more sophisticated, revisable plans that adapt as new information is discovered.
story: Picture hiring a brilliant new assistant on their first morning — smart, motivated, but with no idea how anything in your office actually works. In plain words: The process by which an AI agent decomposes a high-level goal into a sequence of intermediate steps or subtasks before or while executing them. Here is how it actually plays out: Planning capabilities are central to agentic systems tackling complex, multi-step tasks, and can range from simple linear task lists to more sophisticated, revisable plans that adapt as new information is discovered. The model stops being a one-shot answer machine and becomes a coworker that checks its own work. That loop of reason, act, and observe is Planning (in AI agents).
